berkeley-mfe.tuitionLabel: Program & University Fees Class of 2028 FT (enter Jan 2027) — proxy until Spring 2028 / Class of 2029 COA posted; tuition component line $95,353
berkeley-mfe.feesNote: Campus Fee $2,282 + IREF $282 + Documentation Mgmt Fee $119 = $2,683 (Class of 2028 COA). Health Insurance $8,206 (SHIP; waivable with comparable coverage). BIO intl fee $56/sem noted separately. Academic billed program charge published as Program & University Fees $98,036 (tuition component $95,353). Total estimated COA $126,510 incl. living/insurance/books.
berkeley-mfe.period: Class of 2028 FT Spring 2027–Fall 2027 (proxy for Spring 2028 enterers)
berkeley-mfe.notes: SEPARATE TRACK quant-mfe. SPRING-ONLY — no Fall admit (Spring 2028 rounds Dec 1'26–Jul 1'27). STEM CIP 27.0305. Flex 2-yr part-time $3,353/unit from Spring 2027 (28 units). Spring 2028 COA not posted as of asOf — Class of 2028 used as proxy.

cmu-mscf.tuitionLabel: MSCF tuition academic year 2026–27 (Fall+Spring) Pittsburgh or NYC — $35,900/semester
cmu-mscf.feesNote: Pittsburgh AY required fees: Student Activities $248 + Transportation $302 + Technology $490 = $1,040. NYC: Technology $490 (no activities/transport on SFS table). Health Insurance PIT $3,352 / NYC $3,258 (AY). Summer Session rates set by college — total program tuition over ~16 mo (3 academic semesters + required summer internship) not published as a flat sticker; illustrative 3×$35,900=$107,700 unverified for summer billing.
cmu-mscf.notes: SEPARATE TRACK quant-mfe. Fall-only entry; mandatory Aug orientation from Aug 1; required summer internship. STEM (verify CIP on I-20). QuantNet ~$104.6k total not used as official. PIT COA total $110,408 / NYC $112,606 incl. living/insurance/loan fees (as of Jul/Jun 2026 on SFS).

livingCostBand.basis: CMU SFS MSCF 2026–27 AY living: PIT Housing $14,752 + Food $8,664 + Personal $4,098 + Travel $2,990 = $30,504; NYC Housing $15,952 + Food $9,570 + Personal $4,142 + Travel $3,588 = $33,252 (excludes books $2,212 and health insurance).

baruch-mfe.tuitionLabel: Entire-program tuition package out-of-state / international (MFE About page) — NY residents $27,675
baruch-mfe.feesNote: Enrollment-based fees catalog ~$179.60/sem FT (Tech $125 + Consolidated $15 + Senate $1.45 + Activity $38.15). Academic Excellence Fee (AEF) for MS Financial Engineering $375/credit. Catalog estimate OOS: 36 cr × ($855 non-res + $375 AEF) = $44,280 tuition+AEF before enrollment fees — diverges from About-page $42,000 package; re-verify bursar package for Fall 2027. About page still showed stale 2023–24 deadlines as of fetch — package dollars may lag.
baruch-mfe.period: Entire 3-semester program package (About) vs catalog Fall 2025+ rates
baruch-mfe.notes: SEPARATE TRACK quant-mfe. Fall-only; 3 semesters / 36 credits; STEM. F-1/J-1 pay non-resident. Prefer About package $42k intl as published program sticker; flag catalog AEF path may bill higher.
sources: Baruch Graduate Catalog Tuition and Fees

columbia-ieor-mfe.tuitionLabel: Estimated program tuition 36 points × $2,822/point (2026–27 SEAS M.S. rate)
columbia-ieor-mfe.feesNote: Illustrative 3-semester fee stack from 2026–27 Bulletin: IEOR master's program fee FT $1,144 + University Services & Support $703×3=$2,109 + Health & Related Services $759×3=$2,277 + International Services $175×3=$525 + Activities (first-year FT $480 + continuing FT $460)=$940 + Document fee $105 one-time ≈ $7,100. Exact billing depends on enrollment pace. IEOR department tuition page still showed 2024–25 $2,584/cr / $93,024 for 36-cr — superseded by Bulletin 2026–27 $2,822/point. ISSO I-20 estimate for MS Financial Engineering: Tuition & Fees $78,998 + Living $31,625 = $110,623 per academic year (issuance estimate; not full 3-sem sticker).
columbia-ieor-mfe.notes: SEPARATE TRACK quant-mfe. columbia-ieor-mfe (IEOR MSFE) ≠ columbia-msfe (CBS MS Financial Economics). STEM-certified. Fall matriculation. Do not mix with CBS costs.

livingCostBand.basis: Columbia ISSO estimated living expenses for Engineering MS Financial Engineering $31,625 per academic year (I-20/DS-2019 issuance; actual may differ).

sources: Columbia Engineering Bulletin Fees (IEOR program fee)
IEOR Tuition and Fees (stale 2024–25 on dept page)

gt-qcf.tuitionLabel: Out-of-Country MSQCF full-time semester tuition (≥12 cr) Fall 2026 bursar — OOS $21,316; IS $9,103
gt-qcf.feesNote: Mandatory Institute Fees $758/sem at 4+ credits (Fall 2026). International Student Fee (ISF) $100/term for F/J. Health insurance TBD on bursar totals page. Per-hour: IS $759 / OOS $1,778 / OOC $1,829. Program 36 credits — flat program total not published; Fall traditional path includes summer internship (~1.5 yr). Fall 2027 rates not posted as of asOf — Fall 2026 used as current published schedule.
gt-qcf.notes: SEPARATE TRACK quant-mfe. id=gt-qcf (NOT gatech-qcf). Fall and Spring admits; STEM. Use Out-of-Country for typical HK/TW/PRC F-1. GA/GTA rates on fa26_gra.pdf are assistantship-reduced — do not confuse with full sticker.

livingCostBand.basis: GT Financial Aid Out-of-Country graduate COA excluding tuition/fees: on-campus $22,612 / off-campus $25,256 per year (Housing+Food+Books+Personal+Transport; OOC table omits average loan costs).

sources: GT Bursar Fall 2026 MSQCF by credit hour PDF
QCF Tuition & Funding (page still shows 2023–24 narrative)

chicago-finmath.tuitionLabel: Illustrative program tuition if 1,250 units × ($8,017 / 100 units) 2026–27 in-person — unit total from brief/curriculum; confirm exact unit load
chicago-finmath.feesNote: Quarterly Student Services Fee $520; Student Insurance 2026 $1,839/qtr if USHIP; one-time lifetime transcript fee $84 first quarter. Exact fee total depends on number of quarters enrolled (~5 qtr typical in-person). Do not invent multi-quarter fee sum beyond published per-quarter amounts.
chicago-finmath.notes: SEPARATE TRACK quant-mfe. In-person Autumn start; online also January/June. STEM. Enrollment deposit $3,000 credited to first Autumn tuition. Bursar PSD confirms FinMath In-Person 100 units = $8,017. Flat sticker only if unit total known — 1,250 u illustrative from brief (null if curriculum unit total changes).

nyu-courant-mf.tuitionLabel: Estimated tuition 36 points × GSAS $2,426/credit (2026–27 NYU Bursar)
nyu-courant-mf.feesNote: GSAS Registration & Services Fee $503/semester + $81 per credit. Illustrative 3-semester FT path: 3×$503 + 36×$81 = $1,509 + $2,916 = $4,425 (assumes all 36 points billed under GSAS R&S schedule). Confirm actual semester credit splits with program.
nyu-courant-mf.notes: SEPARATE TRACK quant-mfe. id=nyu-courant-mf (NOT nyu-courant). FT Fall-only; summer internship between sem 2–3; optional August bootcamp. STEM. Program states it does not accept applications for financial assistance.
sources: NYU Bursar 2026–2027 Tuition and Fees PDF (GSAS $2,426)
NYU Courant Math in Finance Admissions
GSAS Bulletin Mathematics in Finance MS

stanford-mcf.tuitionLabel: No flat program sticker — Graduate Engineering quarterly: 11–18 units $23,239; 8–10 units $15,100 (2026–27). 45 units over typically 5–6 full-time quarters
stanford-mcf.feesNote: Campus health insurance and other required fees not itemized on MCF pages; see Stanford Student Services for quarterly fees. Do not invent multi-quarter total.
stanford-mcf.notes: SEPARATE TRACK quant-mfe. Not on QuantNet 2026 list. STEM not stated on MCF pages → stem null (verify CIP on I-20). Admissions need-blind; no guaranteed MS funding. HCP part-time path exists.
